**Serves** {{< meta servings >}} · **Active** {{< meta active-time >}} · **Total** {{< meta total-time >}}

Written for a Vermicular Musui-Kamado. No water goes in: once the lid is on,
the onions release enough liquid to braise the chicken. Half the preserved
lemon cooks with the onions and half goes in at the end.

## Ingredients

- 3 bone-in, skin-on chicken legs (about 1 kg)
- 9 g (2 tsp) kosher salt
- 2 tbsp tagine spice blend, divided
- 14 g (1 tbsp) olive oil
- 400 g (2 medium) onions, half coarsely grated, half thickly sliced
- 4 garlic cloves, smashed
- 10 g fresh ginger, sliced into coins
- 1 preserved lemon, rind slivered, divided (or zest of 1 lemon and 15 g
  (1 tbsp) lemon juice)
- 100 g (⅔ cup) green olives
- 15 g (½ cup) chopped cilantro and parsley

## Method

1. Rub the chicken with the salt and 1 tbsp of the spice blend. Refrigerate
   uncovered for at least 1 hr.
2. Heat the oil in the Musui on Medium until it shows Grill OK. Brown the legs
   skin-side down until deep golden, 5–6 min, in two batches if they crowd.
   Brown the skin side only. Set aside.
3. Pour off all but about 1 tbsp of fat. Stir in the rest of the spice blend
   for 30 seconds, then turn the heat off.
4. Add the onions, garlic, ginger, and half the preserved lemon, and scrape up
   the browned bits. Lay the legs skin-up on top. Don't add water.
5. Lid on, Medium, until steam escapes steadily from the lid, 5–8 min. Switch
   to Low for 35 min.
6. Probe the thigh next to the bone. It's done at 185–195 °F. If it's under,
   give it 10 more min on Low.
7. Add the olives and the rest of the preserved lemon. Rest with the lid on and
   the heat off for 10 min.
8. Lift out the chicken. If the sauce is thin, reduce it on Medium with the lid
   off until it coats a spoon, 3–5 min. Taste for salt.
9. Return the chicken and top with the herbs.

## Notes

- Many tagine blends contain salt. If salt is near the top of the label, use
  half the salt.
- Sweet version: skip the lemon and olives. Add 100 g (⅔ cup) dried apricots
  or prunes and a cinnamon stick with the onions, and finish with 1 tsp honey
  and toasted almonds.
